youtube_description:
Dr. Seun Adigun is a two-time Olympic Games athlete; one summer, one winter. Legend status: unlocked. Her first Olympics was in London 2012 when she competed in track and field. Then she founded the first ever Nigerian Bobsled Team and returned to the Winter Olympics in 2018. And she has not slowed down since then...
